overindulge.definition: v overeat or eat immodestly; make a pig of oneself
overindulge.translation:
vi. 溺爱
vt. 过度沉溺, 放纵

overindulged.definition: v overeat or eat immodestly; make a pig of oneself
overindulged.translation: v. 溺爱, 过度放纵( overindulge的过去式和过去分词 )

overindulgence.translation: n. 放纵, 任性, 沉溺

overindulgent.translation: 过分放纵, 过分任性

overindulges.definition: v overeat or eat immodestly; make a pig of oneself
overindulges.translation: v. 溺爱, 过度放纵( overindulge的第三人称单数 )

overindulging.definition: v overeat or eat immodestly; make a pig of oneself
overindulging.translation: v. 溺爱, 过度放纵( overindulge的现在分词 )

overinflated.translation: a. 过于膨胀的,特大的

overinsurance.translation: 保额过高的保险, 超额保险

overinterest.translation: [经] 过多利息, 外加利息

overinterpretation.translation: n. 引申过甚的解释,不够合理的阐释

overinvestment in fixed assets.translation: [经] 过多的固定资产投资

overinvoicing.translation: [经] 开高价发票, 发票价格过高

overirrigation.translation: 过量灌溉; 灌水过多

overissue.definition:
n. An excessive issue; an issue, as of notes or bonds,
   exceeding the limit of capital, credit, or authority.
v. t. To issue in excess.
overissue.translation:
vt. 过度发行, 滥发(公债)
[经] 过度发行, 滥发(钞票,公债等)
